text: Beware of Essential and how it does business. I am extremely disappointed in the Essential PH-1 phone and the company's support model. I bought the PH-1 phone from Amazon who only sells it via third party resellers as Essential the company does not directly sell their phone through Amazon. Within two weeks, the PH-1 camera stops working so I contacted Essential for support. Keep in mind that Essential sells phones but does not have a phone number to contact them for support. They only communicate through email. I describe the problem to them and they request additional information from me: my name, address, proof of purchase, serial number, etc. After providing them with all the data, they inform me that they will not support me because I bought the phone from a reseller. They said they only support the phone if it is bought directly from Essential and Amazon.

The Essential Ph-1 is an amazing device that I would recommend to anyone with realistic expectations. If you want more than 128gb of storage and a headphone jack in lieu of a full screen display and high end build quality, there are many options available at a significantly higher cost.

Hands down the best-designed phone I've ever owned. Migrated to the PH-1 as a former Samsung flagship owner (most recently the S6 Edge), preceded by a Nexus and a Motorola. People close to me have owned iPhones and Samsungs, which I've played around with frequently, so I've had a good sampling of the flagship products for the past several years. I'll say that, unequivocally, the Essential PH-1 is the best-designed phone I've ever owned, by a wide margin. As noted by many others, its industrial design and overall 'feel' is second-to-none. This thing is an absolute joy to use. Once in a blue moon I'm lucky enough to buy something that delights me every time I use it, see it, or pick it up; the PH-1 is exactly such a thing. I read widely about the phone before purchasing it, and the negative reviews made me sufficiently leery to cancel my pre-order.
And in the end you'll be holding what the Essential PH-1 was always meant to be. A love letter to the industry, now at half the price. Hope this helps! Take care!

Also bear in mind a lot of reviewers tend to parrot older criticisms that predate Essentials many updates. It's quite conceivable that with everything Essential is doing, in a month or two Essential Phone PH-1 could well be as good or better than many of its $1000 competitors.
